title: 계산대에서 환불까지: 쇼핑 낱말
objective: You can use words for price, payment, points, and refunds in short shopping sentences, and tell 교환 from 환불 and 일시불 from 할부.
summary: Learn nine words Koreans use to check prices, pay, and return things in a shop.

task.title: Use the shopping words
task.line: Pick a word from the word list that fits each blank or description. You can change its form if needed.

words.meaning: regular price (the price before any discount)
words.example: 이 코트는 정가가 너무 비싸서 세일할 때까지 기다렸어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The regular price of this coat was too high, so I waited for the sale.

words.meaning: to pay (at checkout, by card, cash, or app)
words.exampleMeaning: I had no cash, so I paid with my phone.

words.meaning: paying the full amount at once (card payment, no installments)
words.example: 금액이 크지 않으니까 일시불로 해 주세요.
words.exampleMeaning: It's not a big amount, so please put it through as a single payment.

words.example: 할부로 사면 한 달에 내는 돈은 적지만 오래 내야 해요.
words.exampleMeaning: If you buy in installments, you pay less each month, but you pay for a long time.

words.example: 물건을 살 때마다 포인트를 적립하면 나중에 현금처럼 쓸 수 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: If you collect points every time you buy something, you can use them like cash later.
The sneakers I wanted are already sold out.

words.example: 새로 산 이어폰이 불량이라서 한쪽 소리가 안 나요.
words.exampleMeaning: My new earphones are faulty, so one side has no sound.

words.meaning: exchange (swapping an item for a different one)
words.example: 선물 받은 셔츠가 작아서 큰 사이즈로 교환했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The shirt I got as a gift was small, so I exchanged it for a bigger size.

words.example: 영수증이 없으면 환불이 어려울 수도 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Without a receipt, getting a refund may be difficult.

exercises: Choose 일시불 or 할부: ① 냉장고가 비싸서 12개월 ____로 샀어요. ② 커피 한 잔 값은 보통 ____로 결제해요.
Choose 교환 or 환불: ① 손님: 이거 다른 색으로 바꿔 주세요. 점원: 네, ____해 드릴게요. ② 손님: 이거 필요 없어요. 돈으로 돌려주세요. 점원: 네, ____해 드릴게요.
Fill in the blank: 죄송합니다. 그 색깔은 지금 ____이라서 다음 주에 들어와요.
Fill in the blank: 선풍기를 샀는데 처음부터 안 돌아가요. ____ 제품인 것 같아요.
Complete the conversation at the counter: ① 손님: 세일 전 가격, 그러니까 ____가 얼마예요? ② 점원: 카드로 ____하시겠어요? ③ 손님: 이 카드에 포인트 좀 ____해 주세요.
answers: ① 정가 ② 결제 ③ 적립
